identity.title: Immutable Outcome-to-Score-to-Future-Research Learning Feedback
identity.objective: Add one finite offline caller which verifies frozen S10-R3-FORECAST-01/source grounding receipts, joins later independently timed local outcome records without refitting, scores the originally frozen probabilities on exact eligible/paired denominators and produces bounded future Alpha research recommendations with cold replay. No writes to PIT, Alpha or WP170 registries, no provider calls, trading, paper, scheduler, credentials or capital.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert only these eight authorized tracked paths. Original S10-R3-SRC-01 and S10-R3-FORECAST-01 receipts/implementations, native PIT/Alpha/WP170 stores and PR268 remain untouched; all scratch outcomes and learning receipts are operator-owned, write-once, external to checkout.

api_matrix.reason: One new pure learning composition module, one finite offline CLI, one focused test file and one contract; reuse all existing frozen forecasting, source and native validators read-only.

forbidden_in_this_wp: No automatic mutation/append of canonical Alpha Factory, PIT, WP170 registry, qualification, current priority queue or Hermes memory. A proposed research task is not an accepted canonical ResearchEpisode or a live strategy.
No network/provider/account access, commercial data purchase or side-channel retrieval. Each of six provider integrations remains a separate future owner decision.
No recomputing/refitting prior forecasts using later outcomes or silently replacing historical probabilities, decision times, cohort membership or preregistration evidence.
No automatic evidence-origin promotion or predictive/OOS lift claims from local synthetic and caller-imported labels, or from price-derived Wang models.
No changes to existing S10-R3-FORECAST-01/SRC-01, WP170, Alpha, risk, execution, paper, orders, live authorization, daemon, dependency/lock files, PR268 or unrelated modules.
No new blanket adoption/equivalence closure of the 36 tracked IDs or six external providers; read-only result does not itself approve next WP.
